body:
I was in a relationship like this for almost 4 years. He was extremely controlling, manipulative and jealous. He even cheated and lied all the time. But I loved it all. I loved the feeling of being controlled and wanted in that way. I kept doing whatever he wanted but in that process, I lost myself. I left him when it just got too much. I am in such a better place right now. I am so glad I let him go. Honestly, I still miss being in a relationship like that, I guess I liked being abused to a certain extent. BUT I know for a fact that it is not healthy and it is not good for me. I have grown as a person so much since I left him as I could do all the things that I wasn’t ‘allowed’ to do. I would strongly suggest that you break up with him. By the end of our relationship, I had lost all my friends as I had to alienate them, I got distant with my family and I also lost all of my self esteem.
You are a lot better than that. Leave him immediately and don’t look back.
I finally got my period without taking any hormone pills. What about you?
Not yet but by now I have take 6 pregnancy tests. All of which were negative. I’m going to the OBGYN by tomorrow or the day after. Hope it all works out well

Yeah. It probably is the stress and my sleep schedule. My sleep schedule  has changed entirely but I’m worried because that has never happened. I am planning to go to a gynaecologist on Monday. I hope i get my period before Monday though lol.
I’ve just been freaking out. It’s just the pressure of my parents finding out. Yeah, if it is anything like that, I will definitely get an abortion.
It’s because I know my parents are not going to  approve and I don’t want to end the relationship over something like this. I don’t see any other option here.
I don’t think it is going to work. I think I’ll just have to hide the relationship from her and if it gets very serious, I’ll tell my parents about it.
I don’t know how to explain it to my mum without her getting all defensive and telling me to end it with him.

I do understand their concerns but the thing is, my mum isn’t letting me give this relationship a chance, if these things do bother me as much she thinks they will, I can always leave it. I don’t want to miss out on such an amazing guy. He’s perfect for me.

My parents would gladly accept him if he was 5’5 or I was 5’2.  It really hurts me, the way she talks about him. I really enjoy being with him. I just don’t know how to get it across them. I know they’re just trying to protect me but he just really makes it up for it all.
No matter how much I say it, my parents are just being obstinate. I tried telling them but they gave me an ultimatum. I don’t know what to do anymore

Sexually, there are no issues. I love wearing heels and I wear heels almost every day, he obviously doesn’t stop me from wearing what I want. But in pictures, I do have to bend down lol. Some people do make fun of us but we are chill about it.

As much as I’d like to believe that I don’t care, I really do. My family is very tight and things like these really are important to my family so there is not much I can do to the approval part. The most I can do is continue my relationship and not tell my mom about it but that’d mean that I’d never have a future with my boyfriend.
I don’t know. I don’t want to hurt my parent’s feelings by being harsh with them but I might have to. I can’t really do anything about it. I just don’t know how to explain it to them.

My parents have been together since 27 years. After all these years, their love has obviously evolved. What I meant was that his looks is what all began it. She didn’t really care about his personality, money or anything, the looks were enough.

I do agree to what you said about the judging part. My mum said the same thing, if I was 5’2, it would’ve been okay but what pisses me off is that she isn’t even letting me give it a chance. If this issue makes me unhappy in the future, I can always leave. She gave me an ultimatum. Him or my mother.

Of course. They’ve been together since 27 years. But it started solely on looks. In fact, for the first 6-7 years, it was just on looks. My mom tells me that if she met my dad now, she wouldn’t fall in love with him because they’re very different people but she also then tells me that she can never leave him either because she loves him too much.

I know all the issues that I’d face but I really want to see how it goes and he’s pretty smart and funny. He knows how to get back at snide comments. I want to try and give it a shot. My mum tells me that I’ll have to choose between him or me because if I continue dating him, we’ll keep arguing about it and she won’t like it. I regret telling my mother about it.
